name: Haseeb Khan
summary: Senior Data Engineer with 8 years building medallion lakehouse pipelines on Microsoft Fabric, Databricks, and Azure. Builds bronze-to-gold ELT in PySpark, Spark SQL, T-SQL, and dbt for regulated healthcare data, EHR, claims, and lab feeds covering 100,000+ members under HIPAA and HITRUST controls. Owns pipelines end to end: ingestion, transformation, data quality and freshness SLAs, Power BI semantic models, and on-call recovery.

experience.title: Senior Data Engineer
bullets: Built the EHR, claims, and lab lakehouse on Azure (Data Factory, ADLS, PySpark, Synapse SQL), then moved those pipelines to Microsoft Fabric (OneLake, Fabric Warehouse, Data Factory).
Own silver-to-gold transforms for 20-40 partner EHR, claims, and lab feeds covering 100,000+ CKD/ESKD members.
Build gold marts in Spark SQL and Warehouse T-SQL for risk stratification, hospitalization, and total cost of care.
Implement HIPAA and HITRUST PHI controls with the security team: Purview sensitivity labels, workspace RBAC, column-level security, audit logging, and separate dev / staging / production.
Apply row-level security on Fabric Warehouse and Power BI semantic models for 10+ payor and health-system partners.
Run data quality rules and T+8 hour freshness checks with pipeline alerting on owned feeds.
Build Power BI Direct Lake semantic models on Fabric gold tables.
Tune Fabric Spark jobs, warehouse capacity, partitioning, and incremental refresh with the platform team. Share lakehouse on-call: triage and recover failed clinical loads, and maintain runbooks.

experience.title: Junior Data Engineer
bullets: Built Databricks medallion pipelines (bronze / silver / gold) in PySpark and Spark SQL on Delta Lake; owned silver-to-gold transforms for 10-20 learning, skills, performance, and HRIS/ATS feeds.
Ingested incremental employee and course data from Cornerstone REST/OData and HRIS/ATS APIs into bronze using Auto Loader, across 50+ customer tenants.
Built 25-40 production dbt models in SQL with incremental logic and automated tests running on pull requests.

Used Delta Lake MERGE for change-data updates on late or re-sent HR and LMS files. Scheduled and monitored Databricks Jobs with dbt tests, daily freshness checks, and failure alerts. Tuned job clusters and Delta table partitioning with senior engineers to cut runtime on nightly LMS loads.
Built Algolia indexing jobs on curated course, skills, and people tables, serving search under 200 ms. Worked with HR and L&D stakeholders to turn recurring report requests into governed gold tables.
